details.eligibility: M.Sc / Integrated BS-MS (or equivalent) in the relevant science subject.
details.pattern: Single paper: Part A (General Aptitude) + Part B & C (subject). Negative marking varies by part. Computer-based test, held twice a year (June & December).
details.syllabus: Life Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Physical Sciences, Mathematical Sciences, Earth Sciences (Part A aptitude + subject Parts B & C).

notes: All 3 years in data.js (2024, 2023, 2022) covered. NTA publishes each session's question paper with the provisional answer key on csirnet.nta.ac.in (Public Notices/Archive; portal verified HTTP 200). BYJU'S CSIR NET page (https://byjus.com/govt-exams/csir-net-question-paper/, HTTP 200) covers 2019 and earlier papers only, so it is not listed for 2024-2022. Pre-NTA papers sit on the CSIR HRDG archive (csirhrdg.res.in). YouTube videos verified via YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-21. Next-cycle important dates were not verified — check csirnet.nta.ac.in.
